web-guide-idea-96.audience: Players who enjoy guided games or chess discussion.
web-guide-idea-96.offer: Host a session with a defined level and activity, such as analysing a position or learning a game. Explain rather than merely spectating.
web-guide-idea-96.steps.0: Choose the game and send setup requirements.
web-guide-idea-96.steps.1: Play or analyse with clear turn-taking.
web-guide-idea-96.steps.2: Review a few decisions and invite a rematch or new puzzle.
web-guide-idea-96.equipment: A phone and a suitable board or agreed online game tool. A laptop may make chess analysis easier.
web-guide-idea-96.returnReason: Use new positions, opponents or tactical themes at a consistent level.
web-guide-idea-96.promotion: Share an original puzzle or sample activity and specify what participants need.
